requirements_title: RTC Wi-Fi Services and Maintenance Support
requirement:
APFS Record F2026074247 is updated with the following information:

Estimated Period of Performance Start:  9/28/2026
Estimated Period of Performance End:  9/27/2027
Anticipated Award Date:  9/28/2026



The United States Secret Service has a requirement to procure a contract to provide Gigabyte Internet Service and Wi-Fi maintenance support to the Rowley Training Center (RTC) campus. The contractor shall provide the full range of professional engineering services to design, develop, test, and deploy Wi-Fi capability at RTC.

All services and solutions shall meet USSS and Department of Homeland Security (DHS) policies, standards, and procedures. The contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, supplies, facilities, transportation, tools, materials, supervision, other items, and non-personal services necessary to perform maintenance.

More information will be provided at the release of the solicitation.
